description: A dark, moody painted scene of a single brown wild goat with curved horns and a leather collar with a bell, standing on snowy rocks at the edge of a steep drop. A large fir tree, its branches weighed with snow, leans over it and a fallen trunk lies on the slope to the right. Behind is a misty mountain valley in grey light. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the square edge to edge.
